claim.value: Relevant records may have been altered.
claim.scope: A possible record-integrity limitation; neither a particular alteration nor malicious intent is asserted.

provenance.rationale: The mapping explicitly lists alteration as a possible limitation of records.

signal_basis.value: Cross-check records for agreement on order details and dates, treating conflicting dates, mismatched identities and unsupported retrospective statements as signals of uncertainty; alteration remains a possible record limitation.
signal_basis.scope: These checks can expose uncertainty but do not identify alteration or establish its cause in a particular record.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans supply the cross-checking operation, uncertainty signals and explicit possibility of altered records.
The claim is supported as a bounded possibility, without an unresolved empirical relation needed to license it.

rationale: Records can undergo alteration, so the mapping's reconstruction appropriately retains this possibility. The frozen claim asserts only a possible integrity limitation; it does not infer an actual alteration from disagreement or missing records.
uncertainty: Whether any relevant record was actually altered, and with what intent, remains undetermined.
